title: Pure Battleguard
summary: Battleguard cards paired with generic Level 5 EARTH/LIGHT Warriors, Rank 5 Xyz bosses, and staples; the page's Noble Knight starter (Isolde) is left out. Built around the newest Continuous Spell Battleguard Echoes, the deck swarms Level 5 Warriors and turns self-bouncing and battle-bouncing effects into searches and Rank 5 control.

summary.title: Starters
points: Battleguard Echoes searches a Level 5 EARTH Warrior (Lava Battleguard, Swamp Battleguard, Hayate the Earth Star, or Pyrite Knight) on activation, then discards a card.
Battleguard Cadet searches Feast of the Wild LV5 when Normal or Special Summoned, and Tributes itself to Special Summon a Level 8 Warrior such as Battleguard King from the hand.
Hayate the Earth Star Special Summons itself onto an empty field or alongside a LIGHT monster and summons Tenma the Sky Star from the hand, while Tenma does the reverse for Hayate.

summary.title: Opening: Battleguard Cadet + Battleguard Echoes
steps: Activate Battleguard Echoes to search Lava Battleguard, Swamp Battleguard, or Pyrite Knight, then discard the Level 5 Warrior.
Normal Summon Battleguard Cadet to search Feast of the Wild LV5, then activate Feast of the Wild LV5 to Special Summon up to 2 Level 5 Warriors from the hand and/or GY.

Overlay the two Level 5 Warriors into Constellar Pleiades or Artifact Durendal; when Pleiades or Pyrite Knight returns a monster from the field to the hand, Battleguard Echoes triggers to search Battleguard Howling or Battleguard Rage.

summary.title: Battleguard Echoes & Bounce Triggers
summary.text: Once per turn, when a monster returns from the field to the hand (even during the Damage Step), Battleguard Echoes either adds a Battleguard Rage or Battleguard Howling from your Deck to the hand or changes a face-up monster on the field to face-down Defense Position. Pyrite Knight triggers Echoes on your turn by returning another Warrior you control to the hand to Special Summon itself and give the opponent a Token, while Constellar Pleiades, Battleguard Howling, and Battleguard Rage trigger it on the opponent's turn.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Lava Battleguard and Swamp Battleguard boost each other by 500 ATK for every copy of the partner on the field, while Battleguard King Tributes Warriors to gain extra attacks.
Constellar Pleiades detaches a material as a Quick Effect to return any card on the field to the hand, triggering Battleguard Echoes.

Artifact Durendal detaches a material as a Quick Effect to rewrite an opposing monster effect or Normal Spell/Trap into destroying a Spell/Trap you control, or forces both players to shuffle and redraw their hands.
Imperial Princess Quinquery revives a Level 5 monster to either field, while Number 61: Volcasaurus, Adreus, Keeper of Armageddon, and Tiras, Keeper of Genesis provide Rank 5 removal.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Feast of the Wild LV5 Special Summons up to 2 Level 5 Warriors from the hand and/or GY with their effects negated, immediately assembling any Rank 5 Xyz.

Battleguard Howling activates when a Warrior you control is targeted by an attack or opposing monster effect, burning the opponent for the original ATK of a face-up monster they control and returning it to the hand.
Battleguard Rage grants a Warrior you control 1000 ATK and returns any monster it destroys by battle to the hand instead of sending it to the GY.
